relevance_rank_note: Directly tests apoE4 vs apoE3 effects on a neuronal receptor's surface level, endocytosis and biotin-based recycling (insulin receptor), but in mouse neurons with exogenous recombinant apoE; recycling data are in supplementary figures; no ARF6.

description: Biotin-cleavage recycling assay in primary neurons: after 30 min internalization, more biotinylated IR remained intracellular at 30 and 60 min of recycling with apoE4 than with apoE3, i.e. apoE4 slowed IR recycling to the surface.
quote: significantly higher amount of intracellular IR was detected in apoE4-treated cells compared with cells treated with apoE3 at 30 minutes and 60 minutes, indicating that apoE4 impaired IR recycling
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (slower insulin receptor recycling; more IR retained intracellularly)
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; surface biotinylation with cleavable sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin, glutathione strip, streptavidin pulldown, IR western blot (recycling assay). Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD. Supplement (NIHMS907120) legends and panels read in Chrome via PMC 2026-11-19.
human_check: At 60 min remaining intracellular IR about 49% (apoE4) vs 26% (apoE3) of time 0 (** at 60 min, * at 30 min, p=0.062 printed at 15 min); read off the plot.

description: Biotin-cleavage internalization time course in primary neurons: IR internalization plateaued at 30 min with both isoforms, but at 60 min apoE4-treated cells retained significantly more internalized IR than apoE3-treated cells, consistent with delayed recycling.
quote: apoE4-treated cells exhibited significantly more intracellular IR compared to those treated with apoE3 at 60 minutes, suggesting a delayed recycling of IR in the presence of apoE4 (Figure S8A)
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more internalized IR at 60 min; delayed IR return to surface)
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; cleavable-biotin internalization assay with time course. Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD. Supplement (NIHMS907120) legends and panels read in Chrome via PMC 2026-11-19.
human_check: At 60 min intracellular IR about 70% (apoE4) vs 48% (apoE3) of maximal; effect = relative increase, read off the plot.

description: Cell-surface biotinylation in primary neurons without insulin: apoE4 but not apoE3 significantly reduced the surface IR / total IR ratio (normalized to vehicle).
quote: In the absence of insulin stimulation, we found that apoE4 but not apoE3 significantly reduced the amount of cell surface IR (Figures 5G, H).
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; surface biotinylation (sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin, 4 C) and western blot, surface IR / total IR. Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD.
human_check: Fig 5H viewed: no-insulin surface/total IR ~96% (apoE3) vs ~71% (apoE4) of vehicle; * bracket directly over apoE3 vs apoE4 (legend key *p<0.05, **p<0.01, one-way ANOVA/Tukey). Effect is the apoE4-vs-apoE3 reduction read off bars.

description: Surface biotinylation of several receptors in primary neurons: surface IR was lower after apoE4 than apoE3 treatment with total IR unchanged, i.e. a redistribution rather than loss of receptor.
quote: cell surface IR was decreased after treatment with apoE4 compared with apoE3 (Figures S7A, B) without affecting the total IR (Figures S7A, G)
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (less surface IR, same total IR)
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; surface biotinylation and western blot. Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD. Supplement (NIHMS907120) legends and panels read in Chrome via PMC 2026-11-19.
human_check: Surface/total IR read off S7B: apoE3 about 0.94, apoE4 about 0.83 of vehicle; the single star sits on the E3 vs E4 bracket (*** is vehicle vs E4). Legend key gives only *p<0.05.

description: Same surface biotinylation experiment: surface and total levels of LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR and Na-K-ATPase did not differ between apoE3 and apoE4 treatment, so the apoE4 surface-retention effect was specific to IR in this paradigm.
quote: No significant differences were found in the levels of cell surface and total LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR, and Na-K-ATPase after apoE3 and apoE4 treatments (Figures S7A, C–F, H–K)
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (no change in surface LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR, Na-K-ATPase)
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; surface biotinylation and western blot for LRP1, NMDAR, AMPAR, Na-K-ATPase. Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD. human_check: Note: no Reelin stimulation here, unlike Chen et al. 2010 where apoE4 reduced surface Apoer2/glutamate receptors; the S7A blot labels the subunits as NMDAR (NR2B) and AMPAR (GluR2). S7C-F and H-K are marked N.S. with no P value printed; n=3 independent experiments.

description: Confocal imaging of IR-GFP in SH-SY5Y cells without insulin: about 15% of IR-GFP was intracellular with apoE3 versus nearly 40% with apoE4; insulin increased intracellular IR in apoE3- but not apoE4-treated cells.
quote: nearly 40% of IR-GFP was localized in the intracellular compartment in apoE4-treated cells (Figures 6A–C)
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more IR intracellular, less at the plasma membrane: ~15% -> ~40%)
system: Human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells transiently transfected with human IR-GFP, treated overnight with 100 nM recombinant apoE3 or apoE4 (+/- 100 nM insulin 30 min); confocal imaging, intra-IR/total IR. Deviation: transformed human neuroblastoma line (not astrocytes, not primary), overexpressed tagged receptor, exogenous recombinant apoE; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD.
human_check: Fig 6C viewed: intra-IR/total ~15% apoE3 vs ~38% apoE4 without insulin, **** (legend key ***p<0.001, ****p<0.0001); with insulin N.S. Effect ~2.5x read off bars.

description: In IR-GFP SH-SY5Y cells without insulin, nearly 20% of IR-GFP co-localized with transferrin (early/recycling endosomes) with apoE4 versus less with apoE3; insulin raised IR-Tf co-localization only with apoE3. Lysotracker co-localization did not differ between isoforms (Fig 6B, 6E), so IR is held in endosomes rather than sent to lysosomes.
quote: In the absence of insulin, we found that nearly 20% of IR-GFP co-localized with transferrin in the endosomal compartment in apoE4-treated cells whereas less co-localization was observed in apoE3-treated cells (Figures 6A and 6D).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more IR in transferrin-positive early/recycling endosomes; no change in lysosomal IR)
system: Human SH-SY5Y cells expressing IR-GFP, 100 nM recombinant apoE3 vs apoE4 overnight, Alexa568-transferrin or Lysotracker 1 h; confocal Manders co-localization. Deviation: neuroblastoma line, overexpressed receptor, exogenous recombinant apoE; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD.
human_check: Fig 6D viewed: Tf-colocalized IR ~7.5% apoE3 vs ~21.5% apoE4 without insulin, ***; with insulin N.S. Fig 6E Lysotracker N.S. in both conditions.

description: Surface biotinylation after insulin: about 50% of IR was internalized in response to insulin in apoE3-treated neurons but only about 20% in apoE4-treated neurons.
quote: ~50% of the total IR was internalized in response to insulin in apoE3-treated cells, whereas only ~20% of IR was internalized in apoE4-treated cells upon insulin stimulation (Figure 5I)
system: Primary cortical neurons from E16-18 Apoe-/- mouse embryos (Ara-C at DIV5 to remove glia), DIV10, treated overnight / 30 min with 100 nM recombinant (non-lipidated, Fitzgerald) human apoE3 vs apoE4; plus 100 nM insulin 30 min; surface biotinylation, change in surface/total IR. Deviation: mouse embryonic neurons (not astrocytes, not human), Apoe-null background with exogenous recombinant non-lipidated apoE rather than endogenous APOE genotype; in vitro. Non-aged, non-AD.
human_check: Fig 5I viewed: insulin-induced surface IR reduction ~47% apoE3 vs ~20% apoE4, * (t-test). Effect ~57% smaller response read off bars. This is internalization, not recycling.
